question: Please tell me the Image Color for each of the witches. For example, Emilia is white and purple, that sort of thing.
answer: Sekhmet: black, gray. Typhon: green, blue. Minerva: blue, white. Daphne: purple, black. Carmilla: red, pink. Echidna: white, black. Pandora: gold, white. Hector: gold, brown.
